name: Calvizzano (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Calvizzano (a bald head on white beneath a green chief).
history: Municipal flag of Calvizzano, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Calvizzano arms — bald head on white beneath a green chief, crowned
